@omarkhatibco we can pass `className` prop only if we also passed the `as` prop, because we can't have `className` as a prop on `React.Fragment`.
It works correctly by passing the `as` prop.

```ts
<ErrorMessage as="p" className="test" name={name} errors={errors} />
```
